What is Arffornia built with, from what players touch to the cluster it runs on?
Scope: the game, its website and launcher, how content reaches them, and the homelab platform they run on · derived from code, 2026-10-29
Out of scope: build-only libraries (Gradle plugins, Vite, Pinia) · services of the homelab not used by Arffornia (Nextcloud, Immich, Plex…)
